title: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

OIL AND GAS REGULATORY AUTHORITY
OIL AND GAS
REGULATORY AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002.
ORDINANCE CXV OF 2002
An Ordinance to amend the Oil and
Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part 1, 8th November, 2002]
F. No. 2(1)/2002-Pub., dated 8-11-2002.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby published for
general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Oil and Gas
Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Insertion of section 43A, Ordinance XVII of 2002

OIL AND GAS REGULATORY AUTHORITY
OIL AND GAS
REGULATORY AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002.
ORDINANCE CXV OF 2002
An Ordinance to amend the Oil and
Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part 1, 8th November, 2002]
F. No. 2(1)/2002-Pub., dated 8-11-2002.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby published for
general information:-
2. Insertion of section 43A,
Ordinance XVII of 2002.-----In the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority
Ordinance, 2002 (No. XVII of 2002), after section 43, the following new section
shall be inserted, namely:-
"43A. Ordinance not apply
to certain petroleum activities.----Nothing in this Ordinance shall apply
to upstream petroleum activities and such activities shall not be deemed to be
regulated activities:
Provided that where any holder of
petroleum right claims transportation or transmission tariff for pipeline
connecting the Petroleum field to the point of delivery, the provisions of this
Ordinance shall apply.
Explanation.-for the purposes of
this section, the expression upstream petroleum activities" means all
activities except activities related to LPG and LNG production of LPG and LNG
processing facilities, carried out by the holder of any petroleum right prior
to delivery of petroleum to any purchaser thereof other than a purchaser who is
a retail consumer for natural gas or retail consume, for oil:".
